citation: Rando, Grewal, Sokolov & Kulhanek, "Reversing selectivity of bambusuril macrocycles toward inorganic anions by installing spacious substituents on their portals", Chem. Sci. (2025), doi:10.1039/d4sc07150f (Europe PMC PMC11639902)
license: CC BY 4.0; facts and numbers only, no text or figures reproduced
setting: A bambus[6]uril is a macrocycle of six glycoluril units joined by six methylene bridges. One inorganic anion binds in the centre of the cavity, held by the twelve C-H...X- contacts of the glycoluril methine protons, and the substituents on the nitrogen atoms sit on the two portals. Bromide is a small spherical anion; nitrate is larger and trigonal planar. Apparent 1:1 association constants Ka were measured by isothermal titration calorimetry on tetrabutylammonium salts at 298.15 K, with standard deviations below 17 %.
goal: You need a receptor system that binds bromide as tightly as possible.
ask: Which candidate receptor system should you choose?

constraints.text: the measured apparent association constant for bromide is at least 1 × 10^9 M^-1

candidates.name: BU2 in chloroform
candidates.geometry: The diastereomer of BU1, the same six (S)-1-phenylethyl and six methyl groups but exchanged between the R1 and R2 positions of each glycoluril. The phenylethyl groups point away from the cavity (the open arrangement) and all twelve C-H...X- contacts come out equal in length, so the rigidified cavity is undistorted. Titrated in chloroform.

Ka_NO3.locator: Table 1, row NO3-, column BU2 (CHCl3, 298.15 K, ITC)

Ka_Br.locator: Table 1, row Br-, column BU2 (CHCl3, 298.15 K, ITC)

candidates.name: BnBU in chloroform
candidates.geometry: Twelve benzyl groups on the portals. A CH2 spacer separates each portal nitrogen from its phenyl ring, so the rings can swing clear of the cavity axis and the macrocycle stays flexible and adapts to the anion; in its chloride complex all twelve C-H...Cl- contacts are equal at 3.13 A. Titrated in chloroform.

Ka_NO3.locator: Table 1, row NO3-, column BnBU (CHCl3, 298.15 K, ITC)

Ka_Br.locator: Table 1, row Br-, column BnBU (CHCl3, 298.15 K, ITC)

candidates.reason: 柔性空腔能适应更大的阴离子，但对球形的 Br⁻ 实测 Ka = 6.7 × 10⁸ M⁻¹，比 BU2 低约 15 倍，未达目标。

candidates.name: BU1 in chloroform
candidates.geometry: Six (S)-1-phenylethyl groups and six methyl groups on the portals, the phenylethyl groups at the R1 positions. These bulkier substituents (no CH2 spacer; the phenyl sits on a stereocentre carrying a methyl group) take up the closed arrangement over the cavity axis and twist the cavity into a screw: the two methine C-H...X- contacts of each glycoluril unit differ in length by about 0.3 A. Titrated in chloroform.

Ka_NO3.locator: Table 1, row NO3-, column BU1 (CHCl3, 298.15 K, ITC)

Ka_Br.locator: Table 1, row Br-, column BU1 (CHCl3, 298.15 K, ITC)

candidates.reason: 与 BU2 是非对映异构体、取代基完全相同，只是位置互换导致空腔被扭成螺旋（两个接触相差约 0.3 Å）：实测 Ka = 1.1 × 10⁷ M⁻¹，比 BU2 低 891 倍。

candidates.name: BU1 in acetonitrile
candidates.geometry: BU1 as described for the chloroform candidate, with the same portal substituents and the same screw-distorted cavity, but titrated in acetonitrile instead of chloroform; the macrocycle is unchanged.

Ka_NO3.locator: Table S3 (acetonitrile, ITC); quoted in Results and discussion

Ka_Br.locator: Table S3 (acetonitrile, ITC); quoted in Results and discussion

candidates.reason: 换成乙腈后 BU1 的 Ka 升到 2.6 × 10⁷ M⁻¹，仍比目标低一个半数量级；空腔几何未变。

paper_choice_locator: Conclusions：“BU1 binds inorganic anions up to three orders of magnitude less strongly than BU2 … due to distortion of the BU1 cavity”；Results and discussion 给出 BU2/BU1 对 Br⁻ 的选择性 891；Table 1 的 Br- 行

naive_cue.heuristic: 取代基越大越能把空腔撑稳
naive_cue.note: BU1 与 BU2 的取代基一样大，只是位置不同；决定成败的是位置造成的空腔是否扭曲。

scale.definition: 大环空腔内 C-H...X- 接触长度（BnBU·Cl⁻ 实测 3.13 Å）；BU1 的两个接触相差约 0.3 Å

notes: 与 rando2025-nitrate 共用同一张实测表，四个候选相同，只换目标；因此“未测过”不会被当成“不行”。
表 2 的 ΔGb 与表 1 的 Ka 不自洽（见 rando2025-nitrate 的备注），本题不用表 2。
